name: Scott Franklin
stance: Backs a targeted, size-tiered federal framework of guardrails for the handful of companies building the most powerful frontier AI models.

statements.text: Original cosponsor of the bipartisan FRONTIER Act, a targeted federal framework of transparency, independent evaluation and incident reporting for the most advanced AI systems.
focusing only on the handful of companies developing the most powerful frontier AI models
One of ten signers of the bipartisan leadership letter urging Congress to act on AI oversight, security and transparency.
